name: Link National Reading Panel background source to Reading First

sourceData.title: Report of the National Reading Panel: Teaching Children to Read: Reports of the Subgroups
sourceData.authors: National Institute of Child Health and Human Development, NIH, DHHS
sourceData.method: Research synthesis with topic-specific systematic reviews and meta-analyses
sourceData.finding: Synthesizes research on reading instruction across alphabetics, fluency, comprehension, teacher education and computer technology. Findings vary by instructional component, learner group and outcome.
sourceData.caveat: This historical research synthesis is distinct from the later Reading First funding evaluation. Its included studies, summary report and full subgroup report are not independent program trials.
